PDF.js 6.3.289 (Mozilla, Apache-2.0).
Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.3.289
Registry archive integrity: sha512-ZHjSVpDa3D6izMq8/04lvkhkATUmL9px6ChPaXc1k6nU2Mrhlg1/7F0bdUqCwUjw3NsPTfPZsMDUU6ZIcRaeQw==
Vendored core, worker, character maps, fonts and WASM assets; served locally.
The two build/*.min.mjs files are named pdf.js and pdf.worker.js so existing
Nginx MIME mappings serve these ES modules as JavaScript with nosniff enabled.
API: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/api/draft/module-pdfjsLib.html
